text:
maggie: Hey infra, need a new GPU nodepool in us-west3 for embeddings workload, target 20 GPUs to start. vCPU quota is tight in the org though. Any recommendations on instance type and autoscaler config? cc @samir @dennis

samir: We checked quotas — org vCPU quota in us-west3 is ~1024, so we can't spin up 20 H100s (each H100 is ~96 vCPU). Recommend A10G (48 vCPU) for a balance of throughput/cost, or a mix: A10G baseline + small A2 burst nodes. Also consider 1 GPU per node to keep scheduling simple.

dennis: Can we do a mixed nodepool approach with taints? e.g. a dedicated 'embed-gpupool' tainted gpu=true:NoSchedule and fallback cpu pool for non-GPU pods. For cluster-autoscaler, set balance-similar-node-groups=false to allow heterogenous scaling behavior.

jenna: Quick cost back-of-envelope: A10G ~ $3.8/hr, H100 ~ $12/hr (region price diff possible). So baseline 10 A10G + 10 preemptible A10G burst ~ reasonable. Also need to check NAT egress IP capacity — plan for 2 NAT IPs per 8 nodes for stable outbound.

maggie: Good notes. Pod density question: GPU device-plugin expects some kubelet overhead. If we pick A10G (48 vCPU) what should kube-reserved / system-reserved look like? Concerned about overcommitting vCPU when many small inference pods land.

samir: Kubelet recommendations: set --kube-reserved=cpu=2,memory=2Gi and --system-reserved=cpu=1,memory=1Gi on GPU nodes. Eviction thresholds for memory. Device plugin exposes nvidia.com/gpu and we cap with limits. Example nodepool create snippet: 
```\ncloudctl nodepool create embed-gpu \\n  --zone=us-west3 \\n  --machine-type=a10g.48 \\n  --accelerator count=1,type=a10g \\n  --min=0 --max=20 \\n  --taints=gpu=true:NoSchedule \\n  --labels=workload=embed
```

dennis: Reminder: check GPU SKU quota for A10G in us-west3 before applying. I've opened a quota ticket: https://cloud.console/quota/INC-7891 (status: pending).

infra-bot: autoscaler: detected nodepool request 'embed-gpu' awaiting approval and quota check. To approve run `/infra approve nodepool embed-gpu` or click the link in the ticket.

maggie: :thumbsup: approving now

jenna: One more ops pattern: use preemptible instances for burst capacity and set a taint like preemptible=true:PreferNoSchedule so we can tolerate sudden evictions. Keep baseline reserved nodes non-preemptible for SLAs.

samir: I'll sketch a terraform module with 2 nodegroups (embed-gpu-reserved, embed-gpu-burst-preemptible) and CA config (expander: least-waste, balance-similar-node-groups=false). Will push PR to infra-repo and link it here.

dennis: I'll run a cost and quota simulation in the next hour and paste the numbers.

maggie: Thanks — if the quota increase goes through and PR looks good I'll kick off provisioning and we'll monitor scaling/PodPacking dashboards in console.
